==Usage==
This template should be placed after an objection which is overridden following an [[WP:AC|AgriCorps]] vote. AgriCorps members who need to use this template simply need to put <nowiki>{{Acstrike|~~~~~}}</nowiki> (making sure to use five <nowiki>~</nowiki><nowiki>'</nowiki>s) on an approved [[WP:GAN|GAN]].
